content: Choose Start filling from the form's menu to launch it. Then share its link or invite people to the space as {{formFiller}}. They can choose Fill or open the form to complete their own copy.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the sample form's context menu with the Start filling item. Start filling and Fill are action names; {{formFiller}} is the translated role name (Form filler).

usage.context:
showInsideSpace &&
 menuStep(
 BLANK_FORM_MENU_TRIGGER_SELECTOR,
 CONTEXT_MENU_SELECTOR,
 t("FormsTour:FormsShareTitle"),
 t("FormsTour:FormsShare", { formFiller: t("Common:RoleFormFiller") }),
 callbacks,
 FORMS_TOUR_LABEL,
 [],
 4,
 spaceHooks.reveal,
